description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline IPC component, specifically testing the handling of media data events and IPC communication success/failure scenarios in the Rialto client implementation.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineIpcDataTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the MediaPipeline IPC data handling, including setup and teardown of IPC components and helper methods for creating media data events.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates IPC components, and initializes shared memory info.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, destroys IPC components.

methods.name: initShmInfo
methods.description: Initializes the shared memory info structure with predefined values.

methods.name: createNeedDataEvent
methods.description: Creates a NeedMediaDataEvent with optional shared memory info.
